items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: before he died he told me he said “Kidd, you know what? I’m going to play some of that crazy stuff, you see the next album I do? I’m gonna do some of the crazy stuff you’re doing.”

ctx.x: Right. I mean you’ve got to work up to that.
Yeah but Cannonball was one of my favorite players too. Yeah Cannonball man. And look, changes didn’t mean nothing to him, you know that huh? Cannonball played by ear. Did you know that?
